'''Interstellar Lightspeed Manufacturing''' (or '''ILM''') was a hyperdrive company and a division of [[Sacul Industries Group]]. The company designed the hyperdrive used in the [[StarSpeeder 1000]] [[Passenger liner/Legends|spaceliner]] built by its sister company [[Sacul Aerospace]].<ref name="ST2" />

==Behind the scenes==
This organization was mentioned only in an advertisement on the video screen found exclusively in the queue of ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' at [[Tokyo Disneyland]].<ref name="ST2" />

"ILM" is also the initials -- and alternate name -- of [[Lucasfilm]]'s special effects company, [[Industrial Light & Magic]].
